findings.summary: Of cheliped's four handoff proposals, two ARE this playbook's existing doctrine: seam-contract is v1.26 (seam rule, field-granularity emits, family parity, mutation-scope note) and guard-calibration is v1.25 (motivating-artifact replay, double-existence rule, the what-would-still-be-true trigger). Landing either would have duplicated eight rules. All 13 coverage claims behind the adjudication were cross-checked by a fresh-context claims-verifier over the full 1048-line file (22/22 citations mechanically verified): 11 confirmed, 2 REFUTED — and both refutations SHRANK the additions: probe-the-real-enforcer was already SKILL 131 and last-match-wins ordering already SKILL 603 (T6), so the deny-table block cross-references instead of restating; and the boundary-strengthening false-red case brushed the never-weaken rule as drafted, so it now routes explicitly through the journaled test-wrong unlock class.
findings.disposition: Two rejections recorded; seven deduplicated additions landed (SKILL sections 1, 2, 4, 4a, 9, 10, 12), all rule-d free additions, ledger L-20260813-10 registered first. Cheliped's own status table still marks both rejected proposals 'Proposed' — updating it is a cheliped-session action, flagged to David, not performed from here (write boundary).
